facts.fact: Telecel Group (operator of Telecel Ghana) announced a USD 200 million, three-year network modernisation programme in Ghana under a signed memorandum with Huawei Ghana, up from a USD 70 million agreement of November 2025; the source gives the signing day as not stated, and the investor is a pan-African telecoms group.
